message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters. The cover features five vertical panels, each containing a stylized portrait of a different person. From left to right: a man with a slight smile wearing a gray collared shirt; a woman with dark hair and a neutral expression in a dark jacket; a man with a serious expression; a woman wearing glasses and a gray headscarf; and a man with glasses and a button-down shirt. A small white silhouette of a person with raised arms is positioned at the base of the middle panel.

The background behind the portraits is solid red. Above the title, text reads "KONTROVERSI OBAT COVID-19 PESANAN TNI AD" and "PLUS-MINUS RANCANGAN ANGGARAN 2021". Below the portraits, bold black text states "NYANYIAN PELINDUNG JOKER," followed by a paragraph starting with "SEJUMLAH TERSANGKA PERKARA PELARIAN KORUPTOR KAKAK JOKO TJANDRA..." The bottom area includes a QR code, the date "24-30 AGUSTUS 2020", a price of "RP 45.000", and a barcode. The overall composition is framed by a white border with a red strip along the left and bottom edges.
